questions.question_text: What is the official currency of Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: The Taka is the official monetary unit of Bangladesh.

questions.question_text: Which is the national flower of Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: The Shapla (Water Lily) is the national flower of Bangladesh.

questions.question_text: In which year did Bangladesh gain independence?
questions.explanation: Bangladesh achieved its independence after the Liberation War in 1971.

questions.question_text: Who is known as the Father of the Nation of Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman is the founding father and leader of the liberation of Bangladesh.

questions.question_text: What is the capital city of Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: Dhaka is the capital and largest city of Bangladesh.

questions.question_text: What is the longest sea beach in Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: Cox's Bazar is renowned for having one of the longest natural unbroken sandy sea beaches in the world.

questions.question_text: Which of these is the national bird of Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: The Magpie Robin (Doel) is the national bird of Bangladesh.

questions.question_text: In which division is the Sundarbans mangrove forest primarily located?
questions.explanation: The Sundarbans, the world's largest mangrove forest, is mostly located in the Khulna division.

questions.question_text: What is the name of the main river system in Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: These three river systems dominate the deltaic landscape of Bangladesh.

questions.question_text: When is Victory Day celebrated in Bangladesh?
questions.explanation: Victory Day commemorates the day in 1971 when the Pakistan army surrendered, marking the independence of Bangladesh.

questions.question_text: Who is the designer of the National Memorial (Jatiyo Sriti Soudho)?
questions.explanation: The National Martyrs' Memorial at Savar was designed by architect Syed Mainul Hossain.
